[[File:Pawp-Sabotage.png|thumb|right|200px|A billboard advertisement for Pawp]]
'''Pawp''' was a [[Video store/Legends|video store]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]. Billboards were put up in order to advertise the store. These billboards read "video store" - "Pawp". The logo of the establishment showed the name of the business written in Aurebesh, with the last P ([[Peth/Legends|Peth]]) upside-down.

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:Pawp_concept_art.jpg|thumb|right|160px|Concept art for Pawp]]
Pawp is introduced in the [[Star Wars: The Clone Wars|''The Clone Wars'']] episode [[Sabotage (episode)|''Sabotage'']]. Concept art for ''The Clone Wars'' shows that the business was created for the episode ''[[To Catch a Jedi]]'', where Pawp was a pawn shop simply known as "Pawn".<ref name="SW-To Catch a Jedi - ''The Clone Wars'' Episode Guide">{{SW|url=explore/the-clone-wars/ep519|text="To Catch a Jedi" - ''The Clone Wars'' Episode Guide|nolive=1}} {{C|Slide 6}}</ref>
